text: Official CLI provides command-line access to the whole platform: auth, GPU search, instance lifecycle, templates, volumes, serverless endpoints
quote: The Vast.ai CLI gives you command-line access to the entire platform, authentication, GPU search, instance lifecycle, templates, volumes, serverless endpoints, and more.

text: REST API gives programmatic control over the entire platform and is the foundation of the CLI and SDK
quote: The Vast.ai REST API gives you programmatic control over the entire platform. It's the foundation that the CLI and SDK are built on.

text: Anything done in the web console can be automated from the terminal
quote: Anything you can do in the web console, you can automate from your terminal.

text: Python SDK offers the same operations as the CLI
quote: Automate with the CLI or SDK ... `vastai` from the shell or Python. Same operations, different syntax.

text: Single package ships the CLI, the SDK, and a serverless client for endpoint inference
quote: Provides both the CLI and SDK for managing Vast.ai GPU cloud resources, plus a serverless client for endpoint inference.

text: Python SDK for interacting with Vast Serverless
quote: Interacting with Vast Serverless is made easy through a powerful python SDK.

text: Old vastai_sdk import still works after migration to the new package
quote: Migrating from vastai-sdk? The old import still works: from vastai_sdk import VastAI

text: Agent skill lets AI coding assistants create instances, deploy endpoints, manage SSH keys and check balances
quote: The `vastai` agent skill lets AI coding assistants drive Vast.ai on your behalf — create instances, deploy endpoints, manage SSH keys, check balances, and more

text: Agent skill installs into a coding agent with a single npx command
quote: Install the skill into your coding agent with one command: npx skills add vast-ai/vast-cli --skill vastai

text: Scoped API keys with limited permissions can be created for CI/CD, automation or shared tooling
quote: For shared tooling, CI/CD, or automation, create a scoped key with only the permissions that workload needs.

text: Reserved instances give discounts of up to 50% for pre-paying for GPU time
quote: Reserved instances allow you to get significant discounts (up to 50%) by pre-paying for GPU time.

text: Any on-demand instance can be converted to a reserved instance at any time
quote: You can convert any on-demand instance to a reserved instance at any time.

text: Interruptible instances use bidding and are often 50%+ cheaper than on-demand
quote: Interruptible instances use a bidding system: Lowest cost (often 50%+ cheaper than on-demand)

text: Interruptible instances run at low priority and may be paused
quote: Interruptible: Low Priority. Lowest cost, may be paused

text: Three instance types offer different priority levels and pricing models
quote: Vast.ai offers three instance types with different priority levels and pricing models to match your workload requirements and budget.

text: Autobilling automatically tops up the account from a saved credit card when the balance runs low
quote: Use the autobilling feature to have the system automatically top up your account using a saved credit card when it runs low.

text: Autobilling keeps the balance positive so instances are not interrupted or deleted
quote: Autobilling keeps your balance positive to protect your instances from interruption or deletion.

text: Credit can be added by credit card, BitPay, or Crypto.com
quote: Go to Billing → Add Credit and top up using credit card, BitPay, or Crypto.com.

text: Instances accept SSH keys only; password authentication is disabled
quote: Vast.ai instances are configured to accept keys only - Password authentication is disabled for improved security.

text: SSH lets users log in securely, run commands remotely and transfer files
quote: SSH (Secure Shell) is a protocol for safely connecting to remote servers. It encrypts your connection so you can: Log in securely, Run commands remotely, Transfer files without exposing your data

text: Persistent volumes survive instance destruction and can be reattached to new instances
quote: Volumes provide persistent storage that survives instance destruction and can be reattached to new instances.

text: Storage page for accessing and managing volumes that attach to instances
quote: The Storage page allows you to easily access and manage your volumes - storage that can be attached to your instances for data storage.

text: Local volumes can be added to an instance from the template's Add volume dropdown
quote: Select a template then click on Add volume dropdown. You will see an option labeled Local volume with a + (plus) button next to it.

text: Serverless platform runs compute-intensive workloads without GPU management, billed for execution rather than rental time
quote: Vast Serverless is an AI infrastructure platform that lets you run compute-intensive workloads without managing GPUs, paying for execution rather than GPU rental time.

text: Serverless automatically finds and recruits the best price-performance GPUs to scale a workload
quote: Benchmark-driven scaling: Automatic identification and recruitment of the best price-performance GPU to scale your unique workload.

text: Overlay networks let instances on the same physical LAN share a private virtual LAN
quote: Vast now supports creating *overlay* networks for instances, allowing client instances on different machines on the same physical LAN to share a private, virtual LAN

text: Custom ports can be opened for any Docker image using -p arguments
quote: You can open custom ports for any docker image using -p arguments in the docker create/run options box in the image config editor pop-up menu.

text: A secure Cloudflare tunnel is created automatically for each open instance port
quote: During this loading phase, a secure Cloudflare tunnel will be created for each of your instance's open ports and the browser will test whether these tunnel links are accessible.

text: Prebuilt or custom templates can be launched with one click
quote: Launch prebuilt or custom templates with one click.

text: Prebuilt templates include PyTorch with Jupyter, TensorFlow, and Stable Diffusion image-generation UIs
quote: PyTorch - Ready for deep learning with Jupyter; TensorFlow - ML development environment; Stable Diffusion - Image generation UIs

text: Copyable example deployments for PyTorch, vLLM, ComfyUI, agents and more
quote: PyTorch, vLLM, ComfyUI, agents, and more. Real deployments you can copy.

text: Users can build a template that packages their environment to run on any GPU
quote: Build a template - Package your environment so any GPU can run it with one click.

text: Docker image entrypoint can be overridden in the GUI or CLI
quote: The docker image entrypoint is the main run process, which you can override in the GUI or CLI (--entrypoint).

text: Large template images usually start quickly because they are cached on many hosts
quote: Despite their large size you'll find they generally start quickly because they have been cached on many of the host machines.

text: Secure Cloud machines are verified to be in datacenters with Tier 2/3 or ISO 27001 ratings
quote: Vast verifies that these machines are in a datacenter with a TIER 2/3 rating or ISO 27001. These offer cards have a blue label and are recommended for production

text: Offers can be searched and filtered programmatically by GPU type, count, verification and ports, then sorted by price-performance
quote: vastai search offers 'gpu_name=RTX_4090 num_gpus=1 verified=true direct_port_count>=1 rentable=true' -o 'dlperf_usd-'

text: CLI command queries prices programmatically
quote: CLI: Use vastai search offers to query prices programmatically

text: Search engine filters machines by GPU type, RAM, CPU, bandwidth and more
quote: Our search engine lets you filter by GPU type, RAM, CPU, bandwidth, and more

text: Search page is the main portal for finding machines and creating instances on them
quote: The search page is the main portal for finding good machines and creating instances on them.

text: Offers show a DLPerf performance score and a reliability score
quote: A DLPerf score and a reliability score

text: SDK can search offers, list instances and start instances
quote: vast.search_offers(query='gpu_name=RTX_4090 num_gpus>=4') vast.show_instances() vast.start_instance(id=12345)

text: Full workflow is documented: search for a GPU, rent it, wait for boot, connect, copy data, and clean up
quote: search for a GPU, rent it, wait for it to boot, connect to it, copy data, and clean up

text: GPU instances spin up in seconds at competitive prices
quote: Spin up GPU instances in seconds at competitive prices.

text: Instances give exclusive, never-shared GPU access and are billed by the second for actual usage
quote: Provides exclusive GPU access (never shared between users)... Connects via SSH, Jupyter, or custom entrypoint... Bills by the second for actual usage

text: Marketplace model makes hosts compete on price instead of fixing rates
quote: Vast typically delivers more competitive pricing than traditional cloud providers. The marketplace model creates natural price competition-hosts compete for your business rather than locking you into fixed rates.

text: Hosts can list their machines on the marketplace, set prices and get paid
quote: Host GPUs and earn - List your machines on the marketplace, set prices, get paid.

text: Jupyter notebook interface is available for AI/ML development
quote: Jupyter is an interactive notebook interface that is very popular for AI/ML development using Python.

text: Terminal access with port forwarding and VS Code support
quote: Terminal access with port forwarding and VS Code support

text: Web-based terminal with session persistence for quick CLI sessions
quote: It is a very straightforward web-based terminal with session persistence. It's great for a quick CLI session.

text: Direct connection option speeds up file uploads and downloads from a local machine
quote: This preferred option will establish a direct connection to the instance which is faster for uploading and downloading files from your local machine.

text: Teams can be created, members invited and assigned to different roles
quote: This quickstart guide will walk you through how to create a team, invite new team members and assign them to different roles.

text: Personal credits can be transferred to a team when it is created
quote: To add credit during team creation, select Transfer my personal credits checkbox, enter an amount, and then click Create.

text: NVIDIA GB200 GPUs are available to rent
quote: NVIDIA GB200s are now available. Rent GB200s
